messages.subject: Project Collaboration
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm working on developing a multidimensional IRT adaptive assessment for secondary school Mathematics students in the UK. I'm currently working with a few partner schools to test how impactful this is and I have a large uncalibrated item bank ready. Without domain expertise in psychometrics, I'm looking to collaborate with another member on this project. If you're interested in collaborating on this project, please send me a message. 

Best wishes,
Jay
